subject.title: add option for MCP apps support

question: Should OpenClaw accept this MCP Apps executable-UI boundary and authorize `@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps` plus the direct MCP SDK dependency on the exact current head?
rationale: The PR intentionally expands trusted MCP servers from tool providers into HTML/JS UI providers with session-bound tool and resource access; code review cannot decide whether that permanent core security and ownership boundary is acceptable.

options.title: Approve after repair and proof
options.body: Accept the feature direction after teardown ordering is fixed, exact-head live proof is supplied, and security authorizes the dependency graph.

options.title: Require a narrower design
options.body: Keep the PR open but require a more plugin-owned or differently isolated architecture before approving executable MCP UI in core Control UI.

options.title: Decline the core host
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers do not want OpenClaw core to own executable MCP Apps hosting.

recommendation.title: Approve after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Accept the feature direction after teardown ordering is fixed, exact-head live proof is supplied, and security authorizes the dependency graph.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the rewritten current implementation and is the strongest available owner to coordinate the product, dependency, and security decision.
